messages:
Anya: Opening PR to standardize function/tool calling examples to use a compact envelope response shape. Quick asks: (1) run a schema lint, (2) update SDK snippets, (3) fix the stale example anchor that 404s. Hoping to merge today.

Leo: I will run jsonschema validation and grep for broken anchors.

link-bot: [auto] linkcheck run -> WARNING: docs/faq#tool-examples -> 404.

Pat: I can update python & ts snippets. Which parameter name do we settle on? I vote response_format.

Anya: response_format it is. envelope shape is {"envelope":{"tool":"string","output":{}}} minimal.

Leo: Found a trailing comma in examples/envelope.json at line 22. Pushing a tiny fix now.

link-bot: [auto] re-run linkcheck -> OK: no broken anchors.

Pat: opened snippets PR to change client.invoke(..., response_format="envelope") and adjusted example outputs to match compact envelope.

Anya: added a short migration note in CHANGELOG/docs referencing the compact envelope and how to update client calls.

Leo: schema validator OK after fix, CI passing on docs build.

Anya: thanks everyone. Plan: merge after snippets PR lands and a quick staging smoke deploy. Pat can you kick off staging?

Pat: will do once my PR merges. Leaving this thread open for anything else.
